domain_restrictions: floor(x) is defined for all real x (by taking the greatest integer less than or equal to x)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every real number x, let n be the floor of x (the greatest integer less than or equal to x). Then x equals n plus (x minus n).
quantifier_order: for all x in real numbers
witness_dependencies: No existential witnesses are introduced; the expression uses only x and floor(x).

statement_nl: For every real number x, x = floor(x) + (x - floor(x)).
